q.en: "The team published a detailed ___ of the results."
q.bn: "The team published a detailed ___ of the results."

why.en: "Analysis" is the noun form, needed here after "a detailed".
why.bn: "Analysis" noun form, "a detailed"-এর পরে এটাই লাগবে।

q.en: "It's too early to ___ a conclusion from such a small sample."
q.bn: "It's too early to ___ a conclusion from such a small sample."

why.en: "Draw a conclusion" is the fixed collocation.

q.en: Which pair contrasts two things occurring together with one directly causing the other?
q.bn: কোন pair দুটো বিষয় একসাথে ঘটা আর একটা সরাসরি আরেকটাকে ঘটানোর মধ্যে contrast দেখায়?

why.en: "Correlation" means two things occur together; "causation" means one directly causes the other.
why.bn: "Correlation" মানে দুটো বিষয় একসাথে ঘটে; "causation" মানে একটা সরাসরি আরেকটাকে ঘটায়।

why.en: "Secure research funding" is the standard collocation for obtaining money to support research.
why.bn: "Secure research funding" standard collocation, research-এর জন্য টাকা পাওয়ার ক্ষেত্রে।

q.en: Which stage of the scientific method cycle comes right after "experiment"?
q.bn: Scientific method cycle-এ "experiment"-এর ঠিক পরে কোন stage আসে?

why.en: The cycle runs: hypothesis → experiment → analysis → conclusion → (a new, refined hypothesis).
why.bn: Cycle চলে এভাবে: hypothesis → experiment → analysis → conclusion → (নতুন, refined hypothesis)।
